name: @exaudeus/memory-mcp

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Session start. Returns user identity, preferences, gotchas overview, stale entries. Call once at the beginning of a conversation. Example: brief(lobe: "android")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Pre-task lookup. Describe what you are about to do and get relevant knowledge (semantic + keyword search). Example: recall(lobe: "android", context: "writing a Kotlin reducer for the messaging feature")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

context.description: What you are about to do, in natural language.

tools.name: gotchas
tools.description: Get stored gotchas for a codebase area. Example: gotchas(lobe: "android", area: "auth")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

area.description: Optional keyword filter for a specific area (e.g. "auth", "build", "navigation").

tools.name: conventions
tools.description: Get stored conventions for a codebase area. Example: conventions(lobe: "android", area: "testing")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

area.description: Optional keyword filter for a specific area (e.g. "testing", "naming", "architecture").

tools.name: gotcha
tools.description: Store a gotcha — a pitfall, surprising behavior, or trap. Write naturally; title is auto-extracted. Example: gotcha(lobe: "android", observation: "Gradle cache must be cleaned after Tuist changes or builds silently use stale artifacts")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The gotcha — write naturally. First sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: convention
tools.description: Store a convention — a pattern, rule, or standard the codebase follows. Example: convention(lobe: "android", observation: "All ViewModels use StateFlow for UI state. LiveData is banned.")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The convention — write naturally. First sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Store a general observation — architecture decisions, dependency info, or any insight. Example: learn(lobe: "android", observation: "The messaging feature uses MVVM with a FlowCoordinator for navigation state")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The observation — write naturally. First sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: prefer
tools.description: Store a user preference or working style rule. Stored with high trust. Example: prefer(rule: "Always suggest the simplest solution first")

rule.description: The preference or rule — write naturally.

lobe.description: Optional. Lobe to scope this preference to. Omit for global preferences. Available: default

tools.name: fix
tools.description: Fix or delete an entry. With correction: replaces content. Without: deletes. Example: fix(id: "gotcha-3f7a", correction: "updated text") or fix(id: "gotcha-3f7a")

correction.description: New text. Omit to delete the entry.

lobe.description: Optional. Searches all lobes if omitted. Available: default

tools.name: memory_bootstrap
tools.description: First-time setup: scan repo structure, README, and build system to seed initial knowledge. Run once per new codebase. If the lobe does not exist yet, provide "root" to auto-add it to memory-config.json and proceed without a manual restart.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name. If the lobe doesn't exist yet, also pass "root" to auto-create it. Available lobes: default

root.description: Absolute path to the repo root. Required only when the lobe does not exist yet — the server will add it to memory-config.json automatically.

budgetMB.description: Storage budget in MB for the new lobe (default: 2). Only used when auto-creating a lobe via "root".
